_comment: review_loop config. Pick the executor + reviewer models here. Each role is an adapter: 'shell' runs a command template (wire in your agent CLI/API), 'mock' replays prepared outputs. The reviewer MUST emit a <<<REVIEW-VERDICT {...} REVIEW-VERDICT>>> block (in stdout or review_output). Placeholders in cmd: {model} {role} {round} {prompt_file} {workdir}.

executor.cmd: copilot --model '{model}' --no-interactive --prompt-file {prompt_file} --cwd {workdir}  # REPLACE with your executor agent CLI/API

reviewer.cmd: copilot --model '{model}' --no-interactive --prompt-file {prompt_file} --cwd {workdir}  # REPLACE with your reviewer agent CLI/API
